_description: Default window arrangement — the tab set for the `default-window` command (aka 'New Default Window', bound to Ctrl-Shift-N). The home-module builds a qutebrowser alias from this: the FIRST url opens a new window (open -w), the rest open as tabs (open -t). Keep in sync with the fresh-boot layout (ba_flakes_desktop default-session.json qutebrowser window).
